standard_prerequisites.use: Characterizations of finite presentation for algebras and modules and the Noetherian approximation lemma for finitely presented modules over a limit ring (Algebra); cited inputs, with the two hypothesis verifications written out in the retained span.

core_obligations: Write S = Spec(A), X = Spec(B) and identify the sheaf with a B-module M.
Verify B is of finite presentation as an A-algebra from f being of finite presentation.
Verify M is of finite presentation as a B-module.
Apply the Noetherian approximation lemma for finitely presented modules to obtain F_0 coherent on X_0 with g^*F_0 = F.

proof_roadmap.step: Translate to algebra and verify the two finite presentation hypotheses.
Apply the Noetherian approximation lemma for finitely presented modules.

difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes and a finitely presented quasi-coherent sheaf, the lemma produces a diagram as in the approximation setup together with a coherent sheaf F_0 on the Noetherian approximation pulling back to F. The proof is a written reduction into module algebra: it names the rings and module, verifies the two finite presentation properties with explicit citations, and applies the limit-ring approximation lemma for finitely presented modules. Retained author proof at lines 9776-9787.
